info.title: Educational Framework WebSocket Contract
info.description: Baseline real-time contract for FEAT-002 session events.

/ws/parent.description: Parental control STOMP over WebSocket endpoint. Connections require Authorization: Bearer <token> during handshake.

/topic/family/{familyId}/sessions.description: Family-scoped topic for server-to-client parental session events.

familyId.description: Authenticated family identifier from the opaque token.

/ws/game.description: Native game WebSocket endpoint. No Authorization header is required during handshake. Authentication is performed via an initial auth message after connection. Handshake sequence: connect → send auth → receive AUTH_ACK → send heartbeat/game_action. Connections that do not send a valid auth message within 15 seconds are closed.

GameAvatarEvent.name: GameAvatarEvent
GameAvatarEvent.description: Avatar audio event sent to game client. JSON metadata frame, optionally followed by a binary audio frame correlated by audioId.

eventType.description: Lifecycle subtype. SESSION_CONNECTED: welcome after auth. SESSION_DISCONNECTED: farewell before backend-initiated close.

audioAvailable.description: True when audio binary frame will follow.

audioId.description: Correlation ID for the following binary audio frame. Present only when audioAvailable is true.

text.description: Fallback text. Always present regardless of audio availability.

GameActionResponse.name: GameActionResponse
GameActionResponse.description: Result of a processed game action. Sent after a GameActionMessage is processed by the orchestrator.

difficultyChanged.description: True when difficulty level was adjusted by adaptive difficulty service.

newDifficultyLevelId.description: New difficulty level ID. Present when difficultyChanged is true.

gameCompleted.description: True when this action completed the game.

unlockedAchievements.description: Achievements unlocked by this action. Contains achievementCode, activityId, and topicId.

attemptContext.description: Contextual info about the attempt, e.g. 'streak:3'.

GameClientMessage.name: GameClientMessage
GameClientMessage.description: Messages sent from the game client to the server.

oneOf.title: AuthMessage
oneOf.description: First message sent after connecting. Binds the WebSocket session to an active child session.

oneOf.title: HeartbeatMessage
oneOf.description: Sent periodically to keep the child session alive. Only valid after successful auth.

oneOf.title: GameStartMessage
oneOf.description: Starts a new game for the authenticated child. If an active game exists, it is implicitly abandoned.

oneOf.title: GameReadyMessage
oneOf.description: Transitions the active game from WAITING to IN_PROGRESS. Only valid after game_start.

oneOf.title: GameAbandonMessage
oneOf.description: Abandons the active game. Game is removed from registry.

oneOf.title: GameActionMessage
oneOf.description: Game action processed by the engine. Only valid when game is IN_PROGRESS.

topicId.description: Optional topic context for the action.

GAME_STATE_UPDATE.description: State restore payload sent to game clients after reconnect.

SESSION_EXPIRED.description: Child session expired because inactivity grace window was exceeded.

SESSION_INVALIDATED.description: Family session was revoked externally, usually after a PIN change.

CHILD_EXPELLED.description: Parent or admin explicitly expelled the child from the active session.

PARENT_BLOCK.description: Child is blocked by parental control and cannot reconnect until unblocked.

HEARTBEAT_ACK.description: Acknowledgement emitted by server after receiving heartbeat.

AUTH_ACK.description: WebSocket session successfully bound to an active child session after auth message.

GAME_AVATAR_EVENT.description: Avatar audio event. Sent as JSON text frame, optionally followed by binary audio frame (see BinaryAudioFrame).

SESSION_CONNECTED.description: Lifecycle subtype: welcome avatar sent after successful game WebSocket authentication. Text: 'Hola, vamos a jugar!'

SESSION_DISCONNECTED.description: Lifecycle subtype: farewell avatar sent before backend-initiated session close. Text: 'Vaya, parece que es hora de despedirnos. Hasta la proxima.'

GAME_ACTION_RESULT.description: Result of a game action processed by the orchestrator. Contains resultType, difficulty info, achievements, and completion status.

GAME_COMPLETED.description: Game session has completed successfully. Sent after the final GAME_ACTION_RESULT when gameCompleted is true.

GAME_ERROR.description: Game action failed with an error. Contains error code: GAME_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_ACTION, GAME_NOT_IN_PROGRESS, INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION, NO_ACTIVE_GAME, ENGINE_ERROR, PARSING_ERROR.

GAME_STARTED.description: Game created and waiting to be ready. Payload contains gameId, status (WAITING), activityId, difficultyLevelId.

GAME_READY.description: Game transitioned to IN_PROGRESS and ready for actions. Payload contains gameId, status (IN_PROGRESS).

GAME_ABANDONED.description: Game was abandoned. Can be triggered by client (game_abandon message) or by system events (SESSION_EXPIRED, CHILD_EXPELLED, PARENT_BLOCK). Payload contains gameId, status (ABANDONED).

BinaryAudioFrame.name: BinaryAudioFrame
BinaryAudioFrame.description: Binary frame containing MP3 audio data. Follows a GameAvatarEvent JSON frame when audioAvailable=true. Format: [4 bytes: audioId length as big-endian int32][N bytes: audioId UTF-8][remaining bytes: MP3 audio data]. The audioId field in the preceding JSON frame is used to correlate the binary frame.

code.description: Error code describing what went wrong.

gameId.description: The game ID that caused the error. Present when applicable.

GameStatePayload.name: GameStatePayload
GameStatePayload.description: Payload containing game state. Returned by GAME_STARTED, GAME_READY, GAME_ABANDONED.
